statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. NQ futures are closed for the weekend; Friday's stronger payrolls, higher yields and energy/geopolitical risks keep Stress extreme, but no live one-way price path supports elevated Tail.
recommendation: Current Tail remains below the block threshold. Weekend closure removes live price-path confirmation; the next meaningful structural evidence will come from the Sunday futures reopen.
headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low while rate and geopolitical Stress remains extreme
body: Friday payrolls rose 162,000 with unemployment unchanged at 4.1%. The Nasdaq closed 0.29% lower while semiconductors gained 3.4%, and Treasury yields rose. Hormuz shipping stayed constrained amid U.S.-Iran tensions. With NQ closed, these are conditional reopening-risk inputs rather than evidence of a current persistent price path.
